title: Suno will start scanning outputs for copyright infringment.
summary: It’s the first platform to adopt Musixmatch’s new Sentinel detection service designed explicitly for generative AI. Its sizable database pulls from over 200,000 publishers, including the big three , to identify copyrighted lyrics and compositions.
